title: excellent small group tour to Montserrat with Andrew as our tour guide
text: Andrew was a great tour guy. He gave us a history lesson on Barcelona on the way to Montserrat. He is a very helpful guide, good sense of humour. He pointed out options for the group while we have our free time. He is very pleasant and provided us with a great hint for a dinning spot which turner out to be excellent seafood monger. He is a great asset to Viator Barcelona. I've been to Montserrat many years ago by train. This time with my husband who has not been before. title: Monserrat Tour in November
text: I took this tour for Monserrat and entry to the Basilica and Black Madonna in November, 2026. The tour was half a day and it was terrific. The weather was perfect, the views were incredible  and tour guides, MK and Andres were amazing. They were very knowledgeable, accommodating, patient and helpful. Especially because I was traveling with my family ( husband, 15 year old and a 3 year old). MK helped us with the stroller and we were able to enjoy the Basilica, Black Madonna and the spectacular views. My teenager son had a great time as well as the entire family. The tour was very interesting,
